test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:
.He answered the question ___ confidently, which impressed the panel.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quite**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**quite**" is used to describe the manner in which the person answered the question.
 
• It conveys that the person answered the question in a confident and assured way, which impressed the panel.
 
• **Option 1: "most"** is incorrect because it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "too"** is incorrect because it implies an excess, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "so"** is incorrect because it does not correctly describe the degree of confidence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He answered the question **quite**__ confidently, which impressed the panel."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "most"** is used for comparisons or superlatives but is not suitable in this sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2: "too"** implies an excessive degree, which is not implied in the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "so"** is used to emphasize an adjective or adverb, but does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
